name: footnote-01

tasks.text: What colour is the fill of the banner "3D 프린팅 기술의 미래와 전망"? Answer as `ANSWER: fill=<colour>`.
Which table cells in the file have a bottom border thicker than 1pt? Answer `ANSWER: <cell text>; <cell text>` (the text of each such cell, or `none`).
What are the left indent and the first-line indent of the paragraph "산업용 샘플을 찍어내던 것에서 발전해…"? Answer `ANSWER: indent-left=<pt> first-line=<pt>`.
What is the font size of the paragraph "3D 프린터로 만들 수 있는 물건은…"? Answer `ANSWER: size=<pt>`.
Change the fill of the banner "3D 프린팅 기술의 미래와 전망" to light blue.
Make the bottom border of the banner "3D 프린팅 기술의 미래와 전망" red, keeping its width and line style.
In every table, make the cells of the first row bold with a grey fill (#D9D9D9).
Make the six top-level list items (개념, 3D 프린팅 기술의 장점, 사회적 변화 예상, 문제점 분석, 기대효과, 제도적 대처 방안) dark red (#C00000) and 16pt.
Change the style 개요 3 so that all of its paragraphs turn navy (#1F3864).
In the list item "시제품 제작 시간과 비용 절감…", change "시간" to "기간". Change nothing else: its formatting must stay exactly as it is.
After the list item "저가의 장비 및 S/W 보급…", add a table with a header row 구분 | 내용 whose cells have a grey fill (#D9D9D9), and one row 교육 | 교육과정 신설.
Indent the first line of every body paragraph (the second- and third-level list items) by 10pt.
Give the banner "3D 프린팅 기술의 미래와 전망" a gradient fill that runs from yellow to orange.
